    <RootNamespace>Azure.AI.AgentServer.Core</RootNamespace>

    <Description>Shared foundation for Azure AI Agent Server packages — provides port binding, health probes, OpenTelemetry, graceful shutdown, and the composable AgentHostBuilder.</Description>
    <PackageTags>Microsoft Azure AI Agent Server Core ASP.NET Core OpenTelemetry</PackageTags>
    <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>

  <ItemGroup>
    <FrameworkReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.App" />

    <PackageReference Include="Azure.Core" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.OpenTelemetry" />

  </ItemGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- The model-only TypeSpec projection does not use generated URI helpers. -->
    <Compile Remove="Generated\Internal\RawRequestUriBuilderExtensions.cs" />

  <!-- Ship a global using so consumers can write AgentHost.Run<T>() with zero usings. -->

    <None Include="build\Azure.AI.AgentServer.Core.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build\" />

  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
